# declarative extension Menu views

_status: experimental · owner: core · id: `extensions.views`_

## the one command

```
hosaka extensions enable reference-extension
```

## why you care

A second extension needs no per-package React, routes or frontend rebuild.

## what it does

Discover enabled packages dynamically and render validated host-owned controls, results, errors and tables without extension HTML or core edits.

## entrypoints

- `GET /api/v1/extensions`
- `GET /api/v1/extensions/{identifier}/view`

## what success looks like / what failure looks like

if it works, it's quiet. if it doesn't, expect one of:

- public/cross-site requests and unauthenticated LAN clients are rejected
- disabled/removed packages disappear; unapproved packages render read-only
- unknown UI or executable bindings are rejected before rendering
